name: sap-help
description: Search and read help.sap.com and SAP Community live. One read-only tool, no credentials.
long_description: A single self-contained Go binary, no runtime to install. One tool, sap_help, with actions search, read, community_search, community_read and status. Only anonymous GET requests to public portal endpoints; responses are cached in memory for six hours.

tools.name: sap_help
tools.description: Search and read help.sap.com and SAP Community (actions: search, read, community_search, community_read, status)
